name: Focus Lighting and Fixtures Limited
summary: Focus Lighting and Fixtures Limited manufactures and deals in LED lighting, fixtures, and lighting solutions in India. The company offers recessed adjustable spotlights, recessed downlights, surface mounted spotlights, surface-mounted/suspended, system based spotlights / wall washer, track-mounted spotlights, etc. under the TRIX brand names. Focus Lighting and Fixtures Limited was incorporated in 2005 and is based in Mumbai, India.
